# Noto Sans CJK SC

Tohi-GT7 redistributes the unmodified `NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf` font from the
official [Noto CJK repository](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk).

- Family/style: Noto Sans CJK SC / Regular.
- Font version (name table): `Version 2.004;hotconv 1.0.118;makeotfexe 2.5.65603`.
- Copyright (name table): © 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/).
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; the complete upstream license is in
  [OFL.txt](OFL.txt). The font retains its own license, independent of the emulator.
- Source commit: `f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c`.
- Source file:
  [Sans/OTF/SimplifiedChinese/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/blob/f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c/Sans/OTF/SimplifiedChinese/NotoSansCJKsc-Regular.otf).
- Upstream license:
  [Sans/LICENSE](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/blob/f8d157532fbfaeda587e826d4cd5b21a49186f7c/Sans/LICENSE),
  copied verbatim as `OFL.txt`.
- Font SHA-256: `2c76254f6fc379fddfce0a7e84fb5385bb135d3e399294f6eeb6680d0365b74b`.
- Font Git blob SHA-1: `dc15562470b4f842321894787a0d066879ccff8b`.
- Size: 16,437,364 bytes. This is the complete static CFF OpenType font; it has
  not been subsetted, renamed internally, converted, or otherwise modified.

The runtime uses this font when an opened game font lacks a requested character.
It preserves characters already available in the game's font and does not change
game translations. Windows system fonts may also be read in place at runtime;
they are not included in the release package.

Machine-readable provenance is recorded in [provenance.json](provenance.json).
